searches.answer: Trending tech topics in 2026 include the growing use of AI, which is no longer exclusive to data scientists and software engineers but is being used by traditional knowledge workers to create content through simple text-based prompts. The Internet of Things (IoT) is expanding due to miniaturization, cost-effectiveness, and the availability of shared radio spectrum, though it raises concerns about trust and privacy. Virtual Reality (VR) is being used for upskilling and creating "better-than-real-life" work environments. AI is converging with robotics, leading to faster turnaround times and lower development costs through low-code development. Smart consumer tech and quantum computing are also gaining traction, with projections indicating a significant rise in daily interactions with smart robots and the need for post-quantum cryptography.
